question: Apart from her Divine Protection, does Meili have any other powerful skills? Can she use magic?
answer:
Basically, Meili doesn't have much in the way of individual combat ability. If she fought Petra without any help from mabeasts, she'd lose. However, the ability to use mabeasts is just so ridiculously powerful in the world of Re that she doesn't really need many other skills.

Since Elsa never cooked, Meili can cook!
